title: Report expiry policy
responsibility: Determines whether a report has reached its retention lifetime.

inputs.name: reportRetention.report
inputs.description: Report start timestamp; later updates do not extend this calculation.

inputs.name: reportRetention.now
inputs.description: Optional current time in epoch milliseconds, defaulting to Date.now().

outputs.name: reportCloudPrefixes
outputs.description: Cloud storage prefixes for report evidence, uploaded screenshots and published reports.

outputs.name: reportRetention
outputs.description: True once the start time plus thirty days is at or before now; false before that boundary.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws Invalid report retention timestamp when the start date or current time is not finite.
